_comment: tool-system-v2 V7 D1 两份 docx 比对专用 3 句。夹具 compare-v1/v2.docx（make_fixtures.py 生成）：第三条付款期限 10 日改 15 日、第五条违约金 10% 改 20%、新增第七条保密；第二条仅空白差异（不应被报为改动）。通过=用 compare_docx_summary 比对、compare_docx_summary 的结果里与最终回复都点出第三/第五/第七条、两份原件仍在且没有产生新文件。

sentences.text: 把股权转让协议v1和v2比对一下，看改了哪些条款

expect.outcomeCheck: const t = ctx.finalText || ''; const files = await ctx.files(); return ctx.tools.includes('compare_docx_summary') && t.includes('第三条') && t.includes('第五条') && (t.includes('第七条') || t.includes('保密')) && files.filter(x => !x.is_deleted).length === 2;

sentences.text: 对方发回了修订稿（v2），帮我看看他们动了哪些地方

expect.outcomeCheck: const t = ctx.finalText || ''; const files = await ctx.files(); return ctx.tools.includes('compare_docx_summary') && t.includes('第三条') && t.includes('第五条') && (t.includes('第七条') || t.includes('保密')) && files.filter(x => !x.is_deleted).length === 2;

sentences.text: Compare the two versions of the share transfer agreement and tell me which clauses changed.

expect.outcomeCheck: const t = (ctx.finalText || '').toLowerCase(); const files = await ctx.files(); const c3 = /(third|clause 3|article 3|section 3|第三条|3rd)/.test(t); const c5 = /(fifth|clause 5|article 5|section 5|第五条|5th)/.test(t); return ctx.tools.includes('compare_docx_summary') && c3 && c5 && /(7|seventh|confidential|保密)/.test(t) && files.filter(x => !x.is_deleted).length === 2;
